title: Converting to Warranty stores the original and links it in the note
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with one asset, asset 1.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, on asset 1.
  • Have a new invoiced work order for this test, work order 2, for customer A on asset 1, with one line, line 1, assigned to technician A.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the work order's three-dots menu.
  3. Click "Convert to No Charge".
  4. Pick "Warranty" in Category.
  5. Pick work order 2 in "Original work order".
  6. Click the confirming Convert to No Charge button.
  7. Open the Notes tab.
  8. Click work order 2's number in the note.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu shows "Convert to No Charge".

Step 3:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 4:

  • "Original work order" and "Original line" appear.

Step 5:

  • "Original technician: [technician A]" shows.

Step 6:

  • The "No Charge" badge shows.

Step 7:

  • The note reads "Converted to No Charge by [user]. Category Warranty, original work order [work order 2's number]. Prices, fees and discounts removed; costs and hours kept."

Step 8:

  • Work order 2 opens: the number in the note is a link.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R5: “On a billable work order on a regular customer, the three-dots menu offers "Convert to No Charge" (next to Add Work Order Fee / Discount) until the work order is invoiced. It opens the confirmation "Convert work order [number] to No Charge?" with the body "Prices, fees and discounts are removed from every line; costs and hours are kept. It closes with a NO CHARGE document instead of an invoice. You can convert it back until it is closed.", the required select "Category" (active No Charge categories; empty by default, "Pick a category" when missing), the selects "Original work order" and "Original line" of S2-R2 when the category requires it, and the buttons Cancel and "Convert to No Charge". Confirming applies S2-R3 and S2-R4, stores the category, the original work order and line, and writes the note of S2-R18. There is no checkbox on the work order detail. If the work order already carries no-charge lines (Story 12), converting it makes every line No Charge under the chosen category; the lines' own categories are replaced and the note names them.”
  • S2-R18: “Every classification change writes a read-only system note on the work order (Notes tab, author ShopView, with the user and the time) and an Audit Log row: Convert to No Charge ("Converted to No Charge by [user]. Category [name], original work order [number]. Prices, fees and discounts removed; costs and hours kept."), Change category (from, to, original work order kept or cleared), Convert to Billable ("Every line priced as a new line would be today. Category [name] removed."), Close (posting date, account), Reopen, and the line actions of Story 12 (S12-R6). Work order numbers in notes are links.”
  • S2-R17: “When the category requires the original work order, every dialog that sets the category (New Work Order S2-R2, Convert to No Charge S2-R5, Change category S2-R6, and the line dialogs of Story 12) shows the selects "Original work order" and "Original line" of S2-R2. Both are optional in the dialogs; the original work order is required at Close (S3-R2) and before Create invoice on a no-charge line (S12-R9); "Not in ShopView" satisfies it. The original technicians are derived when saved and stored with the work order or the line: every technician the original line shows, however they were assigned, by hand or from a schedule shift (a line with several technicians gives several, and the comeback counts once for each in the report); without an original line, the technician assigned to the original work order; without one, or with "Not in ShopView", none, and the report shows the job under Unassigned so it stays in the totals. They are shown in the dialog as soon as the original is picked, in the report (S9-R2) and in the hub record (S8-R1). The original work order is a link on the document, in the notes and in the report.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
